decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9772. Series context: trend strength 0.9852 and seasonal strength 0.9999; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.01); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.522.
